nom: Mario Badescu Hydrogel Under Eye Patches

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports a burning sensation, redness, and subsequent swelling and bruising around the eyes after use.

concerns.redness: One reviewer developed angry red skin, swelling, and bloodshot appearance after using the patches, describing this as unsuitable for sensitive skin.

aspects.libelle: Feels secure after a few minutes
Burning and irritation on sensitive skin

extraits.texte: I used these patches in the morning after doing my skincare and immediately felt a cooling sensation. After less than a minute, I felt like they were burning and I took them off. I had angry red skin where the patches had been. Over the next two days, one of my under eyes became swollen and purple with a huge bump and the other eye is completely bloodshot. Not recommended for sensitive skin.
While the gel works, the patches are heavy and will slide down your face. I had to lie down while using them.
I wake up looking so tired all the time. These do help and help with improvement in puffiness but i hate how they slide down the face the first 5-10 min.
They do slide down. I had to adjust them few a times but they do work.

I use these in the morning when heading out and they work great. They're a little heavy at first but I think because they're better quality than ones I've used before and after a couple minutes they feel more secure and so good!

reserve: The sample is very small (7 reviews) and only one reviewer specifies a skin type or concern in detail, so conclusions by segment are thin.
